folded.subject: Their example
folded.object: that of one who kindled a fire

spans.text: [17] AR: مَثَلُهُمْ كَمَثَلِ ٱلَّذِى ٱسْتَوْقَدَ نَارًۭا فَلَمَّآ أَضَآءَتْ مَا حَوْلَهُۥ ذَهَبَ ٱللَّهُ بِنُورِهِمْ وَتَرَكَهُمْ فِى ظُلُمَٰتٍۢ لَّا يُبْصِرُونَ EN: Their example is that of one who kindled a fire, but when it illuminated what was around him, Allah took away their light and left them in darkness [so] they could not see.

folded.id: their hearts|is|disease
folded.subject: their hearts

spans.text: [10] AR: فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌۭ فَزَادَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ مَرَضًۭا ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْذِبُونَ EN: In their hearts is disease, so Allah has increased their disease; and for them is a painful punishment because they [habitually] used to lie.

folded.id: their transaction|has|brought no profit
folded.subject: their transaction

spans.text: [16] AR: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱشْتَرَوُا۟ ٱلضَّلَٰلَةَ بِٱلْهُدَىٰ فَمَا رَبِحَت تِّجَٰرَتُهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُهْتَدِينَ EN: Those are the ones who have purchased error [in exchange] for guidance, so their transaction has brought no profit, nor were they guided.

folded.id: their vision|is|a veil
folded.subject: their vision

spans.text: [7] AR: خَتَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ وَعَلَىٰ سَمْعِهِمْ ۖ وَعَلَىٰٓ أَبْصَٰرِهِمْ غِشَٰوَةٌۭ ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌۭ EN: Allah has set a seal upon their hearts and upon their hearing, and over their vision is a veil.

folded.id: this|is|the book about which there is no doubt
folded.subject: This
folded.object: the Book about which there is no doubt

spans.text: [2] AR: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبُ لَا رَيْبَ ۛ فِيهِ ۛ هُدًۭى لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ EN: This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allah -

folded.id: this|is|what we were provided with before
folded.subject: This
folded.object: what we were provided with before

spans.text: Whenever they are provided with a provision of fruit therefrom, they will say, "This is what we were provided with before."

folded.id: thunder|and|lightning
folded.subject: thunder

spans.text: [19] AR: أَوْ كَصَيِّبٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فِيهِ ظُلُمَٰتٌۭ وَرَعْدٌۭ وَبَرْقٌۭ يَجْعَلُونَ أَصَٰبِعَهُمْ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِم مِّنَ ٱلصَّوَٰعِقِ حَذَرَ ٱلْمَوْتِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ مُحِيطٌۢ بِٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ EN: Or [it is] like a rainstorm from the sky within which is darkness, thunder and lightning.

folded.id: to allah|equals|while you know [that there is nothing similar to him]
folded.subject: to Allah
folded.object: while you know [that there is nothing similar to Him]

spans.text: So do not attribute to Allah equals while you know [that there is nothing similar to Him].

folded.id: when it|is|said to them
folded.subject: when it

spans.text: [11] AR: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ لَا تُفْسِدُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا نَحْنُ مُصْلِحُونَ EN: And when it is said to them, "Do not cause corruption on the earth," they say, "We are but reformers."

[13] AR: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ ءَامِنُوا۟ كَمَآ ءَامَنَ ٱلنَّاسُ قَالُوٓا۟ أَنُؤْمِنُ كَمَآ ءَامَنَ ٱلسُّفَهَآءُ ۗ أَلَآ إِنَّهُمْ هُمُ ٱلسُّفَهَآءُ وَلَٰكِن لَّا يَعْلَمُونَ EN: And when it is said to them, "Believe as the people have believed," they say, "Should we believe as the foolish have believed?"

folded.id: whenever|they|are provided with a provision of fruit therefrom
folded.subject: Whenever
folded.object: are provided with a provision of fruit therefrom

spans.text: Whenever they are provided with a provision of fruit therefrom, they will say, "This is what we were provided with before."

folded.id: who believe|and|do righteous deeds that they will have gardens [in paradise] beneath which rivers flow
folded.subject: who believe
folded.object: do righteous deeds that they will have gardens [in Paradise] beneath which rivers flow

spans.text: [25] AR: وَبَشِّرِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أَنَّ لَهُمْ جَنَّٰتٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ ۖ كُلَّمَا رُزِقُوا۟ مِنْهَا مِن ثَمَرَةٍۢ رِّزْقًۭا ۙ قَالُوا۟ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى رُزِقْنَا مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَأُتُوا۟ بِهِۦ مُتَشَٰبِهًۭا ۖ وَلَهُمْ فِيهَآ أَزْوَٰجٌۭ مُّطَهَّرَةٌۭ ۖ وَهُمْ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ EN: And give good tidings to those who believe and do righteous deeds that they will have gardens [in Paradise] beneath which rivers flow.

folded.id: whose fuel|is|men and stones
folded.subject: whose fuel

spans.text: [24] AR: فَإِن لَّمْ تَفْعَلُوا۟ وَلَن تَفْعَلُوا۟ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱلنَّارَ ٱلَّتِى وَقُودُهَا ٱلنَّاسُ وَٱلْحِجَارَةُ ۖ أُعِدَّتْ لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ EN: But if you do not - and you will never be able to - then fear the Fire, whose fuel is men and stones, prepared for the disbelievers.

folded.id: within which|is|darkness
folded.subject: within which

spans.text: [19] AR: أَوْ كَصَيِّبٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فِيهِ ظُلُمَٰتٌۭ وَرَعْدٌۭ وَبَرْقٌۭ يَجْعَلُونَ أَصَٰبِعَهُمْ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِم مِّنَ ٱلصَّوَٰعِقِ حَذَرَ ٱلْمَوْتِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ مُحِيطٌۢ بِٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ EN: Or [it is] like a rainstorm from the sky within which is darkness, thunder and lightning.
